name: Emma Higgins
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a holistic counsellor who works from a spiritual framework, dedicated to helping individuals achieve well-being and personal growth. My specialization includes Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and narrative therapy, both of which empower clients to embrace their experiences and reshape their personal stories. In addition, I incorporate Nature Therapy into my practice, leveraging the healing power of the natural world to foster deeper connections and promote mental and emotional health.

name: Grecia Sanchez
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am committed to providing a safe, compassionate, and non-judgmental space where clients feel genuinely heard and supported. I understand that reaching out for support can feel vulnerable, particularly when living with anxiety, stress, or the impact of past experiences. I practise in a trauma-informed and client-centred way, recognising that many coping strategies developed as ways of surviving difficult experiences.
